output.answer_markdown: The filings do not support the premise. Costco did not stop charging membership fees in fiscal 2023, so there is no reason to give. Membership fee revenue rose: it increased 8% to $4,580, driven by new member sign-ups, upgrades to Executive membership and one additional week of fees [1]. The annual fee was $60 in the U.S. and varies in other countries [2]. Renewal rates were 92.7% in the U.S. and Canada and 90.4% worldwide at the end of 2023 [3].
